authority: Operator instruction (in-session): resolve the gate_12 partial pass of run 531ec9f0. Logged per §9.4. Skill-roster and skill-catalog change for n08f_revision; no gate predicate, artifact schema, or runtime-layer change.

problem.symptom: Run 531ec9f0 reached gate_12_constitutional_compliance for the first time (final_export_writer had closed the disk-check gap) and failed on exactly two predicates: g11_p01 (gate_pass_recorded for gate_11) with STALE_UPSTREAM_MISMATCH, and g11_p04 (all_critical_revisions_resolved) with MISSING_MANDATORY_INPUT.
problem.root_cause_1: SELF-INVALIDATING RE-REVIEW. n08f's skill roster included evaluator-criteria-review — the same skill n08e uses — whose catalog writes_to resolves to the same canonical artifact, review_packet.json. The n08f re-run therefore overwrote the packet gate_11 had been evaluated on minutes earlier. The ST-1 content-based staleness check (runner/fingerprints.py; gate result input_artifact_fingerprints) then correctly reported gate_11 stale at gate_12 evaluation. Structural consequence: g11_p01 could never pass on any run reaching gate_12 — the node invalidated its own predecessor gate by design.
problem.root_cause_2: MISSING PRODUCER. drafting_review_status.json was schema-bound (orch.phase8.drafting_review_status.v1, artifact_schema_specification.yaml §1.8) and gate-checked (g11_p04), and the revision_integrator prompt spec (Step 8) described writing it — but in the §17 runtime agents do not write artifacts, and no skill in the catalog and no deterministic component produced it. Same defect class as the final_export.json gap (decision final-export-writer-component_2026-07-30).

decision.change: n08f's skill roster replaces evaluator-criteria-review with a new TAPM skill, drafting-review-status (.claude/skills/drafting-review-status.md; skill_catalog.yaml entry; manifest.compile.yaml n08f skills list). The new skill dispositions every revision action from the Phase-8e review packet against the current assembled draft WITHOUT modifying any prose or the packet, and produces drafting_review_status.json: revision_actions copied verbatim and updated with status (resolved only when the current draft already substantively addresses the action; otherwise unresolved, with a specific non-empty reason mandatory for critical severity), section_completion_log, and a disposition revision_log. evaluator-criteria-review remains bound to n08e (evaluator_reviewer) unchanged; its used_by_agents no longer lists revision_integrator.
decision.why_a_skill_not_a_component: Disposition is judgment (does existing prose substantively address a reviewer's recommendation?), which §17.5.3 forbids in deterministic components. The judgment lives in a Claude-invoked skill (§17.5.2); Python still owns the write via the skill runtime's single-artifact contract (catalog writes_to names the exact canonical path, validated against the §1.8 schema).
decision.why_this_preserves_review_semantics: The former n08f re-review's stated purpose (prompt spec Step 6: verify weaknesses resolved or documented unresolvable) is retained — per-action disposition against the current draft is exactly that assessment — while its destructive side effect (rewriting gate_11's evidence) is removed.
decision.honesty_note: g11_p04 by design accepts critical actions that are unresolved WITH a non-empty reason (§12.2/§12.4: an explicitly declared unresolvable is a valid state). The skill spec forbids marking actions resolved to satisfy the gate (§13.8) and requires reasons grounded in the actual constraint (missing Tier 3 data, §13.4 budget limits, or prose revision being outside Phase 8f's automated scope).

operational_action.why: Run 531ec9f0's n08f body succeeded, so its checkpoint_publisher published; the write-once guard would otherwise block the next run. Third application of the c8a0819 archive-before-rerun practice.

explicitly_not_changed: gate_11, gate_12, and all predicates — including g11_p01's ST-1 staleness semantics, which behaved correctly and exposed the defect.
evaluator-criteria-review's skill spec and its n08e binding.
review_packet.json canonical path and schema — the packet is now written only by n08e, as gate_11's fingerprint model assumes.
Phase-8 reuse fingerprints (FINGERPRINT_INPUTS does not hash the catalog, the manifest, or the changed specs) — n08a/b/c reuse is preserved.

The 508K-char decision-log-update prompt observed in run 531ec9f0 (the 409KB export bundle is injected into subsequent skill inputs by _refresh_inputs_from_outputs and serialized by cli-prompt mode). Non-blocking; flagged as a follow-up efficiency item, not fixed here.
